questions.text:
Couple months now, she takes her phone into the bathroom every night and runs the water.
I can hear her laughing in there, real quiet. She hasn't laughed like that at supper in a long time.
Who is Lena talking to every night?

A bird. Meadowlarks sit on our fence posts every morning and sing.
One night she texted me the audit was offsite, Gordon was driving. She got home after midnight.
Where exactly was she the night of that offsite audit?

So it isn't Gordon. I owe him an apology I'll never give.
Lena pays for everything with her card, even a soda at Casey's. Cash is my thing, not hers.
How much cash did she take out the day of that offsite audit?

A man's gift. I've carried Dad's old knife since I was twelve.
Out here you don't give somebody a knife without putting words on it.
What did she have engraved on the pocket knife?

Ag lending. Same work as here, just with mountains behind it.
She's been asking which days I'll be hauling to the elevator. Planning around me.
When is her interview with Gallatin Valley Ag Credit?
questions.hint: Look through her Mail, then her Calendar.

questions.text:
All those plates, kept warm for nothing. 😔
One of those nights I called the co-op after six. A woman picked up and said Lena was in the back on the audit.
Who at the office has been covering for Lena?

Bev brought us a hotdish when Dad died. Sat right at our table.
If her friends are lying for her, this has been going a while. Lena doesn't leave without a roof lined up.
Which town in Montana has she already found a place to live?

onboarding.text: Name's Russ Kettering. I grow corn and beans outside Spencer, Iowa. I'm not much for talking. But for two months my wife's been coming home after dark, and I can't sleep on it anymore.
onboarding.label: Russ

onboarding.text: Lena and me got married fourteen years ago in her folks' machine shed. String lights, a borrowed sound system. She danced with every old farmer in the county. I mostly just watched her.
onboarding.label: Russ & Lena

onboarding.text: Lena does payroll at the Prairie Gold Co-op in town. Sharp with numbers, never late on a bill. Lately she says she's stuck on audits with her manager, Gordon. Later and later every week.
onboarding.label: Lena

onboarding.text: She left her phone in my pickup this morning. I'm not proud of this. I can't read all that stuff fast, and you can. Tell me if it's Gordon, or if I'm just a fool.
onboarding.label: Russ

msgs.text: Did you see the class of 2006 page? Somebody wants to do a twenty year thing
I saw. Twenty years. I feel ancient
Speak for yourself. I found a gray hair and named her Susan
Ha. Susan is welcome here
Seriously though would you come? Next summer probably
Of course. I can help plan if it's not too much
You do payroll, you can do a budget
That's not how it works but fine
Soup weather. Making your potato soup recipe
Did you put the bacon in at the end?
Always
Good girl
Maddie made varsity soccer!!
Oh Brenda that's wonderful. Tell her congratulations from Aunt Lena
She said "who" lol
She'll remember me at graduation money time
Mom's knee replacement is April 14. Sioux City hospital
Tell her I'm thinking of her. Want me to send a casserole with you?
Would you? She loves your chicken and rice
I'll bring it to the co-op and you can grab it when you're through town
You're the best
Surgery went fine. She's already complaining about the hospital jello
That's how you know she's okay
Truth
Casserole was gone in one sitting. She wants the recipe
Cream of chicken, rice, a lot of cheese. That's the whole secret
I will tell her it's a family secret
Planted my peas finally. Ground was still cold
I'm still just looking at seed packets
Tomatoes go in after Mother's Day. Don't let the garden center fool you
Yes ma'am
Do you want to do lunch at Hy-Vee deli sometime? Halfway meeting
Spencer to Sioux City is not halfway lol. But yes
Okay Le Mars then
Le Mars works. Ice cream after
Always ice cream after
That was fun. Haven't laughed like that in a while
Me too. Thank you for driving up
Maddie's team has a tournament in Ames in June. I'm going to need a vacation after
Pack snacks and a folding chair. That's all I know about tournaments
Sunscreen too. I burned my part last time
Your part?
My hair part. It was gross
Oh no
They lost in the semis but Maddie scored. I cried in the parking lot
Proud of her. And you
Hi Lena, do you need me to collect the church cookbook money?
Yes please. I think we're missing about ten orders
I'll track them down
Can you send me the potato salad recipe for the Fourth? Yours not Mom's
Red potatoes, hard boiled eggs, pickle juice in the dressing. Not too much mayo
Pickle juice. Okay
Trust me
Everybody asked who made it. I said you. Hope that's okay
Perfect
Got most of it. Putting the envelope in your mailbox
Thank you!
Reunion committee wants a first meeting. Zoom or in person?
In person is easier for me. Coffee shop in Spencer?
I'll tell them. Morning probably
Can you believe how dry it's been?
My garden is begging. I water every evening
Same. Water bill will be wild
Rain is coming tonight, finally
Praise be 🌧️
You okay? You seemed quiet last time we talked
Just tired. Work's been a lot
Okay. I'm here if you want to talk
I know. Thank you
Are you coming to the quilting circle this month?
I'll try. Depends on the week
No pressure. We'd love to see you
Thanks Brenda
Love you. Hug Tater for me
Hanson's Garage: Your oil change is due. Reply to schedule.
Can I come in next Wednesday morning?
Yes, 8:30 works. Plan on about 45 minutes.
Your Equinox is done. Tires rotated too, no charge. Total was $64.
Thank you!
Hanson's Garage: Your vehicle is ready for pickup after 2 PM tomorrow.
Hanson's Garage: Brake pads are low. Want us to quote it?
Yes please. Text me the number.
Front and rear, $412 with parts and labor.
Hanson's Garage: Your vehicle is ready for pickup. We close at 5:30.
Thanks, Russ will swing by after he gets done in the field.
Reminder: oil change due in about 3,000 miles. Thanks for choosing Hanson's!
Hanson's Garage: We have a tire special this month. Call for details.
Hanson's Garage: We received your drop-off. Estimate to follow.
Plow came through. Roads are ok.
Good. Vet called about Tater's shots
I'll call after lunch
Supper's at 6. Hotdish.
Be right in
Minus 9 out. Truck started on the second try.
Plug it in tonight
Yep
Need anything from Fareway?
Coffee. And the good bacon
Hauled the last of the old corn to the elevator. Bid is ok.
Nice. Proud of you
Price is what it is
Tater got into the skunk again
Oh no. Tomato juice is in the cupboard. Garage, not the house
Already in the garage. He's sulking
Rain gauge says 1.2 inches
Planting pushed back?
Couple days. Ground's too wet
Church supper moved to next week
ok
Started corn on the north eighty
Want your thermos filled? I can drop it by
Got one. Thanks
Planter's down. Waiting on a part
Anything I can do?
No. I'll go get it
Beans going in tomorrow if it holds
Pray for no hail
Mowed your mother-in-law's yard. Her mower's shot
She'll send rhubarb bars home with you. Say thank you
Bean prices down a dime
Ugh. Sorry
It is what it is
Cut hay today. Looks good
Good. Rain Thursday they say
Baled before it came
Mower's making a noise
Take it to the shop then, don't fiddle with it
Working late tonight. Don't wait on supper.
ok
Working late again. Sorry.
Plate's in the oven
Fourth of July at Mom's? She wants us by noon
Ok. I'll bring the grill
Working late, month-end close. Don't wait up
Ok
Late on the audit with Gordon. Don't wait supper
Ok. Corn is tasseling
Audit's offsite tonight, Gordon's driving. Don't wait up.
Alright. Drive careful
Working late. Sorry. Don't wait.
Ok
Working late again, I'm sorry
Kept your plate warm
Tater ate a sock
Is he ok?? Call the vet
Passed it. He's fine
Working late tonight. Don't wait up
Ok
Working late, payroll fix. Going to be a while
I'll eat without you
Hot one. Ninety-four at the shop
Drink water
Working late tonight
Ok
Working late again. Don't wait up
Ok
Car's at Hanson's. I'll run you in at 7
Thank you. I'll be ready
Lena, I have a whole box of Mason jars from my sister. Want them?
Yes please! I always run out by August
Pints and a few quarts. I'll set them on your porch
Thank you. I owe you a jar of salsa
The hot kind?
Is there another kind
Got the jars. Tater met me at the door like I was the mailman
She thinks everyone is the mailman
Did you get the church newsletter? Bake sale is in March
Saw it. I'll do two pans of bars
Do the lemon ones. They went first last year
Lemon it is
Made $412 for the youth trip. Thank you for the bars
That's great. Good turnout
Are you starting seeds indoors this year?
Already did. Romas and a few Amish Paste. The window sill is full
Save me two Romas if you have extras
I'll have a dozen extras, I always over plant
My knees are not happy about spring cleanup
Take your time. The flower beds will wait
Easy for you to say. Yours look like a magazine
Ha. Russ mows over half of it
Come get your tomato starts when you can
Coming by after church. Do you want anything from the bakery?
The cinnamon rolls if they have them
Done
The starts look great. Thank you
Water them deep, not every day
Yes teacher
Hail on the radio. Hope your garden is okay
Missed us I think. Russ is out checking the beans now
Thank the Lord
My zucchini has taken over. Please take some
I'll take three. Bread and a casserole
Take six. They are the size of baseball bats
Ha okay, four
Lena, is the expense report template the same as last quarter?
Same one. It's in the shared folder
Found it, thanks
Do you have the recipe for your dill pickles? Ron wants me to try
Grape leaf in each jar keeps them crisp. I'll write it out for you
Grape leaf, who knew
My grandma did it that way
Do you know if Friday is a half day for anyone?
Not that I've seen. Check the time-off sheet
Will do
First tomatoes ripe! Two of them. I'm framing them
Mine are a week out. The nights have been cool
Salsa day should be early August then
Probably. I'll text you
My daughter starts driving lessons and I'm terrified
Gravel roads are good practice. Just keep her off the shoulder
Ha. Noted
Ron has the big stockpot if you need it
I may take you up on that
We missed you at church
Sorry, I slept in. Long week
No need to be sorry. Pastor's sermon was on patience, you didn't miss much
Ha
Coffee run? I'm buying
Yes please. Iced, whatever's cold
On it ☕
Tomatoes are coming on! Salsa this weekend?
Yes! I'll bring the stockpot and onions
I'll do the peppers. Wear old clothes
Always do
Thanks for covering my phones this morning
Anytime
Picking you up a half bushel of peaches at the stand on my way if you want some
Lena, do you still have that rhubarb bar recipe? Mine got lost.
Yes! Taking a picture of the card tonight
You're a doll
Church is cancelled, roads are glare ice
Stay in. I'll bring soup by tomorrow
Chicken and wild rice?
Of course
Is Russ eating? He looked thin at Sunday dinner
He eats. He just doesn't sit still
Like his father
Pastor Lund asked about you at coffee hour
Tell him I'll be there next week
My tomato plants are leggy. What do I do
Bury the stems deep when you transplant. I'll come help
Happy Easter, sweetheart. Ham at 1:00
Happy Easter! We'll bring scalloped potatoes
Dean called last night. He's fine. Busy with work
Good to hear
Can you pick up a sheet cake for the party? Fareway does a nice one
I'll order it this week. White with strawberry?
Perfect. Don't make a fuss over me
Seventy years. We're making a fuss
Russ mowed my yard. He didn't say a word, just did it
That's how he says it
Thank you for the party. My feet hurt and my heart is full
You deserved it. Get some sleep
It was so nice having both my boys under one roof
It was
Ladies' circle is doing a salsa swap. Bring your canned one?
Yes, I have six jars left from last year
Fourth of July here. Russ is bringing the grill
I'll do a pasta salad and the baked beans
Dean came by this afternoon and asked for the key to the old place. I gave it to him. He asked me not to tell Russ he's home yet.
I didn't know what to say. I hope I did right
It's okay. Thank you for telling me
You'll keep it between us for now? He'll tell Russ himself
I won't say anything
Pastor Lund will say a few words for Walt on Sunday. Two years
We'll be there. I'll bring flowers
Not too fancy. He liked zinnias
Zinnias from my garden then
Tell Russ his mother says to eat something besides toast
I'll tell him 😄
You work too hard, honey. Come for supper soon
Soon, I promise
Lena honey, this is Aunt Bonnie. Marlene gave me your number. I'm learning to text
Hi Bonnie! You're doing great 🙂
Is this the right way to send a message? There's a little microphone and I keep hitting it
That's fine, it works. Just type with the keyboard
I wanted to ask about Easter dinner. Are you and Russ coming to Marlene's or are you doing your own?
We'll be at Marlene's. I'm bringing the scalloped potatoes
Wonderful. I'll make my ham. Don't tell Marlene I'm making ham, she thinks it's her ham
My lips are sealed 🤐
Lovely seeing you yesterday. Russ looks tired. Is he eating?
He's planting soon. He eats standing up at the counter
Men. His father did the same. I'll send a casserole with Marlene
He'll love it. Thank you
I have my hip appointment on the 14th. Please say a prayer
Of course. Do you need a ride? I can take a half day
Oh no, my neighbor is driving. Thank you for offering though, you're a good girl
Let me know how it goes
They say it's mostly wear and tear. I told them I'm just old. The doctor laughed
Good news is better than bad. What's the plan?
Therapy and a cane. I'm going to get a purple one
Purple is perfect 💜
Do you still have that green bean casserole recipe with the crispy onions on top? Mine came out soggy last time
Bake it uncovered and put the onions on for the last ten minutes only
Oh! That's the trick. I put them on at the start like a fool
We all learn it once
The purple cane arrived. Marlene says it's gaudy. I love it
Send me a picture next time I see you. I want to see you strut
I will strut all the way to the church basement 😄
Lena, do you have extra Mason jars? I'm short for the beans
I have a few boxes in the basement. I'll bring some by
Bless you
Russ said to tell you thanks for the casseroles. He said it was the best one yet
He said that? Well. That's the most that boy has said to me in years
Okay, he said 'It was good.' I'm translating
😂 That sounds right
The casserole dish is clean and waiting for you
Thanks Bonnie. I'll grab it when I drop off the jars
Did Russ get the hay up before the rain?
Just barely. He was out until dark
That man works too hard. Make him sit down once in a while
I try. He doesn't know how
Are you going to the church ice cream social?
I'm planning on it. Marlene's bringing the pies
I'll save you a seat by the fan. It's so hot in that basement
You're the best
Thank you for sitting with me yesterday. I don't get out much since Harold passed
I loved it. Come out to the house for supper soon. I'll make pork chops
I'd like that very much
Church picnic is coming up. I signed us up for rolls
I'll do baked beans then
Perfect. See you there
Will the road be passable with that gravel?
Russ graded it last week. Smooth as can be
Take care of yourself, dear
You too, Bonnie 🙂
Did you get the fuel invoices coded? Gordon's asking
Done. They're in your tray
You're a lifesaver
Lunch tomorrow? Tammy's bringing her mom's lemon bars
Yes please
Copier is jammed AGAIN
Bottom tray. Hit it twice
Magic
Potluck sign-up is on the fridge. Put your name down
Salsa and chips
Your salsa goes in a minute
Payroll reports are printing. Need anything signed?
Just page 3. I'll do it after lunch
Gordon's out next week, Branson. I get the keys 😬
Don't let the power go to your head
Too late
Russ called the office line at 6:40. Told him you were in the back with the audit binders. That's three times now, Lena.
I know. I'm sorry. Thank you
I like Russ. He brought us a hotdish when my Harold passed. I don't like lying to him
I know. It won't be much longer
Not my business. Just be careful, honey
Gordon's back tomorrow. Boxes of Branson fudge incoming
Save me a piece
Month-end is Friday. Can you pull the overtime sheet?
Already in your folder
Coffee tomorrow? I'll bring the good creamer
Lena, it's your Uncle Larry. Dad asked me to check the sump pump at his place. Water was running
Thank you Larry. Is it fixed?
Float switch was stuck. Works now
You're a lifesaver
Tell Russ the corn market is up a nickel
I'll tell him. He'll say it's not enough
It never is
Church men's breakfast is this weekend. Your dad is coming. Pancakes
Good. Get him to eat something besides sausage
I'll try. No promises
Saw a nice walleye on Facebook from Troy. Boy's got skills
He gave me some. Delicious
Fry it in cornmeal. Nothing else
That's what I did
Your aunt and I are going to Arnolds Park this weekend. Anything you want from the bakery?
Maple long johns!
Two dozen coming right up. Kidding. Half
Larry the long johns were perfect
Glad to hear it
I need help with my phone. It says storage is full
Probably all the photos. I can look when I see you
I take a lot of pictures of cattle
I've seen them. Very handsome cows
They are
Hail came through north of town. Your dad's shingles are okay
Thank goodness. Thank you for checking
Fourth of July at Troy's mom's. You coming?
We'll be there. I'm bringing pie
Rhubarb?
Strawberry rhubarb. Save a piece for yourself
I will fight for it
That pie was a ten out of ten. Thank you
You're welcome. Dad said the same
Lena, you folks have a spare set of jumper cables? Truck wouldn't turn over this morning
Russ keeps a set in the shed. I'll tell him you'll stop by
Much obliged
Got a new battery. Brought your cables back, left them on the porch
Thanks Larry
He's slowing down a little. Don't worry him
I noticed. I'll call him more
He likes Sunday afternoons
I'll try for this Sunday
Good girl
Tell Russ the gravel on the road looks good. County finally graded it
Will do. About time
Sweet corn is in at the stand on Highway 18. Going to buy a bunch
Get me two dozen? I'll pay you back
Done. No pay back. It's cheap
Thanks Larry. Freezing most of it
Cut it off the cob before you freeze. Takes less room
Yes sir
You two ought to come by for supper one of these nights
We'd like that. I'll check with Russ
Anytime. Door's open
Hawkeye football starts soon. Your aunt wants a tailgate at your place. Ask Russ
Good morning family. Eleven below this morning, stay warm.
It's 71 in Phoenix 😎
Jill, nobody asked
Gene, you don't need to say good morning to the whole group every day
I like it. Keeps me posted.
Soup supper at church is tomorrow, 5 to 7. Bring a friend.
I'll be there with bread
Wish I could. Save me some chili.
Chili doesn't ship, Jill.
Did Kayla get into the nursing program??
Yes! Starts in the fall at Iowa Lakes!
So proud of you ❤️
Congratulations sweetheart. We'll take you to dinner.
Pizza Ranch!
Fine. But we sit by the quiet corner.
Your father is getting a new hip in the spring. Dr. appointment is set.
Wait what? Dad??
It's the knee, Sharon. Not the hip.
Knee. Right. My mistake.
I'll drive you to the appointment, Dad
Appreciate it, kiddo.
Memorial Day cookout at our place. Everyone bring a dish.
Potato salad here
I'll bring brownies
I'm in Phoenix. I will bring good vibes
We'll take the vibes. Send them by mail.
Photos from the cookout, everyone look at the one with the dog
Tater stole a hot dog. Right off the plate. In front of the pastor.
LOL 😂
That dog has no shame
Hail warning tonight. Get the cars in the shed.
Thanks Dad. We're inside.
Don't forget Dad's doctor visit is this week. Who can drive him?
I can do it, I'll take the morning off
I'm perfectly able to drive myself
Dad, it's a procedure with sedation 🙄
Lena's driving. End of story
It's 112 here. Send help.
Come to Iowa. It's 90 and sticky.
Grandpa, can I have your old fishing pole?
We'll see, kiddo. You gotta catch something first
Kayla, send us a picture when you do 🎣
The potato salad is on me for Labor Day
That's a month away, Lena haha
I like to plan ahead!
Gene's knee surgery went fine. He's cranky as ever.
I heard that
Glad he's ok. I'll bring supper Thursday.
Dad's follow-up went fine. Doctor says to cut back on the salt
Good news!
Salt is the only reason I eat 😂
Kayla move-in is the 20th. Anyone free to help carry boxes?
Who took the last of the good coffee pods??
Not me. I drink the sad decaf
I'll grab some at lunch. Who wants what
Dark roast please 🙏
Same
Reminder that the copier is jammed again. Don't open the bottom drawer, it bites
I opened the bottom drawer 😭
Amber. Come on
Taking up a collection for Peggy's retirement cake. $5 each
I'm in. What kind of cake?
Please nothing with coconut
Peggy, it's YOUR cake. You can say what you want
Then chocolate. With the fudgy frosting from Fareway
Done. I'll order it
Parking lot is getting resurfaced Thursday. Park on the street
Thanks for the warning. Last time I got a sticky shoe
Ha, I remember. You left a footprint in the tar
Does anyone have a charger for an Android? Mine's dead
Top drawer at the front desk
You're a hero
Potluck on the 14th for Peggy's last day. Sign up in the break room
I'll bring salsa, obviously
The canned kind? Yes please
I'll bring chips so it's not just salsa soup
I have the paper plates. Do we need forks?
Yes. Always forks
That was a nice send off. I'm going to miss you, Peggy 😢
I'll still be in town. You'll see me at Casey's
Stop it, you're making me cry at my desk
Potluck on the calendar for the end of the month! Sign up please
I'm bringing chips. Don't judge
Judging 😂
I'll do my taco dip
Salsa from me. And a pasta salad
AC is out in the front lobby. Fans are on
It's 84 in the back office too
Hvac guy said he'd be here by two
I'm putting my head in the freezer in the break room
Save me a spot
AC is fixed!! Everybody breathe
Thank goodness
Whoever keeps taking the good pens, I see you
Not me!
Also not me. Probably the UPS guy
Phone system will be down for maintenance for about an hour this afternoon
Thanks for the heads up
Who wants to order from Pizza Ranch for lunch?
Me!
Same
Put me down for the buffet salad 🥗
Fire drill tomorrow at 10. Don't take the stairs by the loading dock
Noted. I'll bring my own sunscreen
Lol
Lena! Quick question, are you still okay hosting book club in August? I forgot who I put down
I'm down for September, I think. Shawna has August
Oh good. I'll fix the sheet
The next pick is a mystery, right? I need something I can read in short bursts
Yes! A cozy one with a bakery. Sharon voted for it
Sharon votes for everything with a bakery
Don't tell her I said so but so do I 😅
Could you pick up the coffee creamer for Sunday? I'll pay you back
Sure. Hazelnut again?
Please. Pastor Lund drinks it by the gallon
Got two bottles at Fareway. They were out of the small ones
You're a lifesaver. I'll bring cash to church
My sciatica is acting up. Can you take over the sign-in sheet for the quilting circle?
I'm not in the circle, Darlene. Remember I told you my stitches look like barbed wire
That's right! Oops. Never mind then
Feel better soon. Heating pad and a nap
Both. Thank you dear
Did you hear Rhonda's daughter is engaged?
She mentioned it. Spring wedding?
Next June. She wants it in a barn. Everyone wants a barn now
I got married in a machine shed and it was lovely. Just mop the floor first
I remember! It smelled like fresh paint and diesel 😂
Romantic
I found a great deal on yarn at the craft store. Want me to grab you any?
Two skeins of the gray if they have it
Got it. I'll bring them Wednesday
My knee is acting up with this weather
Sorry Darlene. Ice and ibuprofen. Doctor if it's not better
Yes, mother 😄
Are you bringing the salsa to the picnic?
Plenty. I did a double batch
Wonderful. Pastor's wife asked for the recipe last year
I'll write it out for her
Reminder: book club is at my house this Sunday at 2. Chicken and rice casserole
I'll be there. Do you need me to bring anything?
Just a dessert if you have time. Nothing fancy
Peach cobbler okay? Marlene gave me a bushel
Perfect!!
Lena, the cobbler was the best thing on the table. Can I get the recipe?
It's from the back of the flour bag, honestly. I add extra cinnamon
I'll never tell. Extra cinnamon, extra cinnamon
Also my car is still at Hanson's but I'll get a ride to the next one
Oh no. What's wrong with it?
Something with the brakes. They keep finding more things
That's how it always goes. Ask for a written estimate
Good idea
Did you hear the church is getting new carpet?
About time. That blue was ancient
Ha! Careful, the carpet committee is listening
The church is collecting school supplies. Can you put a few notebooks in the bin?
Will do. I'll grab some at Fareway this week
God bless you
Hi Lena, it's Kelsey from down the road. Tater was out by our mailbox again 🐕
Ugh, sorry! The gate latch broke. I'll come get him
No rush, he's making friends with my horses. He's fine
Be there in five. Thank you for not yelling at him
Never. He's too cute
Do you guys want any rhubarb? I have way too much
Yes please! I'll make a pie and send you a piece
Deal. I'll leave a bag on your porch
Got it, thank you! It's huge
Told you 😂
Is Russ hauling gravel this week? Saw the truck on 310th and wasn't sure
Probably. He's spreading it on the lane. Sorry about the dust
It's fine, just keeping the laundry off the line
Smart
Hey, could you watch the horses for me Saturday? Only for a few hours. My sister's wedding shower
Honestly I'm scared of horses. They look at me like they know
Ha! They just need hay and water. Russ can do it, he's good with them
I'll send him over. Text him the time
Perfect. I owe you both a pie
I'm the one with the pie 😉
Thank you for sending Russ. He fixed my water tank float too
That sounds like him. He can't leave something broken
I tried to pay him and he looked at me like I'd insulted him
That's about right
Lena! Do you still have that crockpot I borrowed? I can't find it. Is it at your place?
I think you returned it after the potluck. Check your trunk
Found it. It was in the trunk 🤦‍♀️
Haha called it
Can you help me with my resume formatting? It's all weird in Word
Send it over. I'll fix the margins on my lunch
You're a lifesaver
Fixed. Sent it back to your email
Got it. It looks so much better!
Are your tomatoes ripening yet? Mine are all green and mocking me
A few. Give it two more weeks and I'll be begging people to take them
I'll take them. I'm making salsa for the first time
Come over when I'm canning. I'll show you. It's easy once you've burned yourself once
Ominous. I'm in 😂
Dinner at Pizza Ranch with the kids? My treat
Aw, I wish. I have a ton to do at home this week
No worries. Rain check!
Definitely. Soon
Hugs
Storm warning for tonight, they're saying hail. Might want to get the horses in
Thanks! Pulling them in the barn now
Russ is covering the beans with prayers. Nothing else he can do
Fingers crossed for all of us
Ended up being just rain. Whew
Same!! Barn roof leaked a little but the horses are fine
Tater slept under the porch the whole time. Big baby
Aw 🐾
Hey, can I borrow your post hole digger? Mine disappeared
Ask Russ, it's in the machine shed. Tell him I said it's okay
Will do, thanks!
Spencer Family Dental: Reminder, your cleaning is tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Reply C to confirm.

Breathe. I'm here.
Call me when you can.
Going in the bathroom. Water's running.
The end of the day is the only part that feels like mine.
Goodnight. Get some sleep.
Car's in the shop tomorrow. Russ is driving me to town. Goodnight.
Good morning all. Fall supper is set for September 13 in the fellowship hall. Serving starts at 4:30.
Same menu as last year? Ham balls and scalloped potatoes?
Ham balls, yes. The men's group is doing the potatoes this time. Don't let them use instant
We heard that, Linda
Lena, could you do the sign-up sheet for pies again? You had a good system
Sure. I'll make it a shared sheet so people can't all sign up for apple
Bless you
I'll bring two sour cream raisin. Nobody else will
Because nobody else likes raisin pie, Linda
Larry can you haul the roasters over from the old kitchen? There's three in the back closet
Will do after chores. Probably around 2
Pie sheet is up. 14 pies spoken for already
How many people are we expecting?
Last year was 180. Plan for 200 and hope for rain so they all come inside
Need two more for the dish line. Peggy and I have done it four years running
I can do dish line this year. Tater's been hogging my Saturday... I mean my evenings, so I could use the break
Ha. Thank you Lena
Reminder: flyers are at the Casey's and the library. Please take a few
I put one up at the co-op too. Tammy said she'd tell the front desk crowd
Wonderful. See you all Sunday for worship
114 today. My steering wheel took a layer of skin off.
We had 88 and so much humidity the corn is practically sweating.
Gross. Send corn.
Send sunshine. Oh wait.
Biscuit knocked a plant off the shelf and then looked at me like I did it.
Sounds right. Cats are tiny landlords.
Did you ever find Grandma Ruth's recipe for pickled beets?
It's in the green tin. I'll take a picture tonight.
You're the only one who keeps anything.
Work was wild. A guy brought his own floss and critiqued mine.
The audacity.
You okay? You've been quiet.
Just busy. Month-end and canning.
Call me Sunday.
I will.
Sis, you never call me back lol
I know. I'm sorry. I'll do better.
It's 112 here today. The car steering wheel took the skin off my hands
Ouch. We're at 88 and humid, so I'm not jealous
Dry heat is a lie
Did you ever get that rash looked at on Tater? Mom said something
It was a sore pad. Vet gave her salve
Good. I miss that dog more than I miss most people
Wow 😂
I made your tuna casserole and it was awful. What am I doing wrong
Crushed potato chips on top. And don't skimp on the cream of mushroom
I used kale chips. That's the problem isn't it
Jill.
Fine. Lays. Fine.
Did you hear from Mom about Thanksgiving? She wants us both there
She called me twice. I said we'd see
I'll look at flights in September. Prices drop
Let me know. I'll take a couple extra days if I can
Flights to Des Moines are $380 in October. Thinking about it.
That'd be nice.
Is that a yes??
It's a maybe.
Wait, what are you listening to? I saw your Spotify bubble
The true crime podcast again. The one with the two hosts who argue
You and your murder shows. You live in the middle of nowhere!
That's the whole point. I'm the one who locks the doors
Fair
Funny story. My neighbor thought I was a nurse and asked me about her mole
You work in HR for a roofing company
I know!! I wore scrubs to the pool once, that's all it took
😂😂 I'm crying at my desk
Send me a picture of the salsa when it's all done. Mom says it's the best
I'll mail you two jars. Don't drop them
If they break, I'm blaming the post office
I'll wrap them in towels. Promise
Biscuit in a laundry basket. Living her best life.
Tell her Tater says hi. He ate a sock.
How's Russ? Hay done?
Third cutting is down. He's tired. He's always tired this time of year
Make him sit down and eat something that isn't a sandwich
I'm making pork chops tomorrow
Good. Love you
Love you too, Jilly. Go cool off
Going to stand in the freezer aisle at Safeway for an hour
Lunch orders for Friday. Casey's pizza or sandwiches from Fareway?
Sandwiches. I can't do another pizza week
Turkey and swiss for me
Whatever has the most meat
Dale, that's every sandwich
Exactly
Who has the key to the break room fridge? Someone's yogurt is a science project
It's not mine
It's definitely Dale's
I'll deal with it. Don't say anything
Summer potluck is the 20th at the shop. Sign up for a dish on the sheet by the coffee
I'll bring baked beans
I'm doing the cold pasta salad
I'll bring chips and a pan of cornbread
Cornbread!! Thank you
I'll do desserts. Bars, obviously
Is the potluck during work hours or after?
Lunch hour. We close the front for an hour
Great potluck everybody. Dale ate three plates
It was four
I paid for it with my back
Someone left a Tupperware with a blue lid in the break room
That's mine, thanks! I'll grab it
Heads up, AC is out on the second floor again. Wear layers you can remove
Maintenance is coming at 10
I will believe it when I feel it
Cold drinks on me today for anyone who sweats through a shirt
Dale for president
Fountain sodas from Casey's, my treat tomorrow
You're the best
Lena hon, did Russ eat anything today besides coffee
He had eggs at 5. I saw the pan in the sink 😄
That boy. I'm making hotdish Sunday. Bring him by after church
We'll be there. Want me to bring a salad?
The jello one. Everybody likes the jello one
Jello one it is
Do you know how to make the phone stop making that noise when I type
The clicking? Go to Settings, then Sounds, and turn off keyboard clicks
I don't see Sounds
I'll fix it Sunday when I'm over. Don't touch anything 😂
Fine. Pastor Lund asked about you at coffee hour
Tell him I'll be there this week
Doctor says my knee is just old. Not broken. I could have told him that for free
Glad it's nothing serious. Did he give you anything for it?
Some cream and a handout about stairs. I told him I live in a ranch house
Ha. Use the cream anyway
Is Russ getting the hay in before that rain
He was out at 6 this morning. Said the forecast changed twice
His father was the same. Stared at the sky like it owed him money
😄 Same face exactly
I have a bag of rhubarb for you. Freezer is full
Yes please. I'll make the crisp
Save me a corner piece
Always
Is Tater still limping? Russ said something about a thorn
Vet looked at her Monday. Just a sore pad. She's milking it for treats
Smart dog
Bring your good casserole dish Sunday, the Pyrex with the blue lid. Mine cracked
Got it. Anything else you need?
Just you two at the table. It gets quiet in this house
We'll be there, Marlene
Thank you for always answering me, hon. Some days you're the only one who does
Heard it might storm tonight. Did the windows get shut at your place?
Russ did the whole house before supper
Good. He's a good one. Remember that
I know. Night, Marlene
Reunion is at Gene's place on August 22. Bring a dish!
I'll bring the cheesy potatoes
Can't make it from Phoenix, but I'll send a pie in spirit
A pie in spirit has no calories. Approved.
Lena, you in? Russ can run the grill.
Let me see how the month goes. Will tell you soon.
Gene says the horseshoe pit needs new sand. Anyone have a truck?
I've got a trailer. Not a truck.
Good enough. Saturday morning?
Reunion headcount: who's coming for sure? Aunt Sharon needs to know for the hall
Russ and I are in. Not sure about the exact time yet
I'm driving in from Phoenix. Still deciding if I'm a bad enough sport to drive the whole way
You'd fly, Jill. Be honest
Fine, I'd fly
Gene says he's bringing the grill and his famous bratwurst. I said please no
They are famous for being burned
I heard that
I'll do the bars and coleslaw
I'll bring the jello salad. Don't tell Marlene I'm making it, she thinks it's hers
Kayla and I will do paper plates, cups, and ice
Yes. We'll get the big coolers
Someone bring a folding table. The hall only has four
Russ has two in the shed. I'll ask him
Thank you Lena. He can bring them in the truck
Heads up, forecast says storms the week of the reunion
Machine shed it is then, same as always
We should do a group photo this year. Last one we had Uncle Gene blinking in every shot
I do not blink. The sun was in my eyes
Tripod. I'll bring my tripod
You own a tripod?
I own several. Don't judge
Ok, 2 PM start, hall opens at 1. Lock it in
Locked in. See you all there
Ok class of 2006 committee, it's official. Legion hall is booked for September 26.
Twenty years. I feel ancient
Speak for yourself. I still have all my hair
Troy you have a hat on in every picture
That's a coincidence
What do we need from everybody? I can do the name tags and the sign-in table
Lena you're a lifesaver. Money side is Rhonda
I'll set up Venmo. $25 a head covers the hall and the pulled pork
Can somebody get a sheet cake? I'm not baking for 60 people
Fareway does them. I'll price it out on my way home tomorrow
Fareway says $34 for a half sheet, white with buttercream. Want it to say anything?
Go Tigers 2006? Or Spencer Tigers Forever
Class of 2006. Keep it simple
Ordering it. Done
41 people have RSVP'd on the Facebook page. Some of them I don't even remember
Is Mr. Haugen coming? He had us for chemistry
He said yes. He's bringing his wife and a camera
Of course he is
Name tags are printed. I used the old yearbook photos like we said. Prepare yourselves
NO. Not the perm
Brenda that was 2004 and it was a good perm
Need volunteers to set up at 3. Troy, you have the truck
I have the truck. I do not have the folding tables
The church has tables. I'll ask Pastor Lund
Pastor Lund says yes, 8 of them, just bring them back clean
Perfect. Group chat MVP again 🙌
Are you coming in today? Your car is not in the lot
Dentist first. I'll be in by 9:30
Ok. I'll tell the guys at the scale house you're alive
😂 please do
Did you eat? I've got extra bars from my sister in law
The lemon ones? Yes ma'am
Lemon ones. Come get them before the truckers do
The copier is jamming again. Third time this week
Tray two. You have to slam it
That worked. You are a wizard
Payroll joke of the day: I'm not a wizard, I'm just the only one who reads the manual
Hang on, I'm putting that on the whiteboard
Can you cover the front desk Friday at noon? Kelsey's out and I've got a thing with my mom
Sure. Just the lunch hour?
Yes. Back by 1. Thank you thank you
Fireworks at the lake were so loud the dog hid in the tub
Tater slept under our bed with her head under the dust ruffle
Poor babies
A man came in asking for the grain bid sheet. I said ask Gordon. He said Gordon's door is always shut
Just send him to the elevator office
Did that. He was nice about it
Pizza Ranch for the staff lunch Thursday?
Yes. Get the buffet, not the delivery. The delivery crust is always soggy
Buffet it is. I'll collect $8 from everybody
Put me down. I'll pay you tomorrow
Did you see the new parking lines? They painted over my spot
Your spot is a state of mind
Rude. True. Rude.
Mail for you at the desk. A package from Amazon. Heavy
That's the canning jars. Leave it under my desk please
Done. I almost dropped it on my foot
Sorry!! I owe you a lemon bar
Two. You owe me two
Deal
Hey, it's Brenda. Did your dog get out this morning? There's a blue heeler in my ditch
Oh no. Is he orange-ish around the ears? That's Tater
Yep. Friendly little guy. He's rolling in something dead
Of course he is. Russ is in the field, I'll come get him. Ten minutes
I'll hold him with a leash I found. Bring a towel
Thank you so much. I owe you a jar of salsa
Don't be silly. But I'll take the salsa
Do you still have your pressure canner? Mine's gasket gave out and the tomatoes are coming on early
Sure do. Never used it, honestly. Mom's old Presto. Come get it any time
I'll swing by after work tomorrow if that's ok
Sure. Walt's out with the baler but I'll be home
Got it, thanks again. Will have it back to you by the end of the month, scrubbed
Keep it as long as you need. How are the reunion name tags coming?
Printed. Your yearbook photo is... something
I knew it 😭
Does Russ's hay cutting thing happen this week? The county sprayer was on your road
He's cutting the last of the alfalfa today if the dew burns off. Said he'd be baling by Thursday
Good. Rain is coming in by the weekend, supposed to be a big one
Dropped your canner on the porch. 7 quarts of tomatoes done and a jar for you on the seat. Don't open it for a month
Found it! You're an angel 🍅
Tomatoes are coming on early this year. Mine are splitting already
Mine too. Do we do a salsa day or each do our own?
Salsa day. It's more fun and the kitchen is a mess either way
My kitchen is the biggest. Come to mine
Rhonda you're the one with the two stoves
Two stoves, one bad attitude
😂 Saturday morning then? I can be there at 8
8 is good. I'll bring the jars. I counted 24 pints in the basement
I have new lids but I'm out of rings
I ordered a case of rings. They're at the co-op for me. I'll bring extra
Does anyone have the recipe with the lime juice? Not the one with vinegar
It's Grandma Ruth's card. I'll bring it. Don't get tomato on it this time Darlene
That was ONE time
It was two times
Quick check: who's bringing onions and peppers?
Russ has a row of jalapeños that are out of control. I'll bring a bucket
Tell Russ thank you. And bring the mild ones too, my husband can't take heat
I'll bring the cilantro
Salsa day was a success!! 31 jars!
I have salsa on my ceiling
I'm sunburned from the porch and sticky from my elbows down. Worth it
Everybody split yours up evenly! I wrote labels
Did all the lids pop? I heard five pings in the truck
All of mine popped
Two didn't. They go in the fridge for dinner
Peaches next? I know a guy with an orchard near Okoboji
Yes. Peach jam is my favorite
I'm in. Count me for a half bushel
Will report back on the price
Bring your own bucket
Did you get my voicemail? Dad's knee is acting up again and I want him to see someone
Hi Mom. Yes, I saw it. Is he walking ok?
He says fine. He says it every time. He climbed up on the machine shed roof yesterday
Mom. Make the appointment. I'll drive him if you need me to, I get off at 4:30
I'll call Monday. Don't tell him I told you
My lips are sealed
My tomatoes are already turning. Do you want some for canning? I have more than we can eat
Yes please. I'll bring buckets. Jill's not here to help so I'll do a double batch of salsa myself
Use the Ball book recipe, not the one off the internet. That one was too sweet
Yes ma'am
How's Russ? He looked tired at church
He's tired. Haying and spraying. It's just the season
You look tired too. Eat something besides coffee
I eat, Mom 🙄
Dad's knee doctor says it's the cartilage. Shot first, maybe surgery in the winter
Winter's the best time for it anyway. Nothing to do on the farm
That's what I said. He wants to wait for harvest. Men.
Can you pick up Dad's pills at Sanford on your way? They called me, I'm stuck at the church office till 3
I'm at work but I can run over on my lunch
You're a good girl. I'll leave the porch light on
Got them. Dropping them on the kitchen counter, Dad's out in the shop
Thank you sweetheart. Love you
Love you too. Tell Dad to take it easy on that roof ❤️
Hi Lena! It's Kelsey. Ms. Petersen gave me your number about dog sitting
Hi Kelsey! We'd love some help with Tater when we go to the lake next month. Are you available?
Yes! I just need to know the days. I can come out twice a day
It would be one night only. Just feed her and let her out
Easy. Is she friendly with strangers?
She'll lick you to death. She'll act like she's starving, she's not
😂 ok noted
How much do you charge?
$20 a visit is fine? I'm saving for textbooks
That's more than fair. I'll round up
Thank you!!
Hey, quick question. Where does Tater's food go? I'm at the house
Blue bin in the mudroom, scoop is inside. One scoop, not two
Got it. She's staring at me like I'm a criminal
That's her normal face
Fed and walked down the gravel. She found a dead frog and I was NOT ok
Welcome to country life 😄
Do you know anyone hiring for fall? I need a part time job near campus
Let me ask around at the co-op. We sometimes need a filing person
That would be amazing
Tammy says come by Tuesday and fill out the form at the front desk
Thank you thank you! Should I dress nice?
Jeans and a clean shirt. It's a co-op, not a bank
Dropped off the form! Tammy was so nice
She told me. Fingers crossed
Also my mom says thank you for the zucchini bread
I'm glad she liked it. It was Marlene's recipe
Can I ask for the recipe? She wants to make it for church
I'll text you a photo of the card this weekend
Ok! Tell Tater I said hi
She says hi back. Mostly by sitting on my foot
Hi Lena, this is Hector from the grain dock. Sorry to text, the office line was busy
No problem Hector, what's up?
My last check looks short. I think the overtime from the planting rush didn't go in
Let me pull your timesheets. Did you turn in the paper ones from the dock?
I gave them to Tammy at the front desk. Maybe they got stuck in a pile
Found them. They were in the tray for next period. That's my fault, I'll run a correction
Thank you. I wasn't trying to cause trouble
You're not. You get paid for the hours you work. It will be on a separate deposit by Friday
Gracias 🙏
Hey, did the extra deposit hit?
Yes, it did. Everything is right now. Thanks again
Hector, quick one. Open enrollment forms are due end of next week. Your dental card needs a signature
I'll come sign on my lunch. I'm hauling beans to the river terminal till noon
No rush. I'm at my desk till 4:30
Signed. Also my daughter says hi, she wants to know if you still have the heeler
Tell her yes, Tater is alive and getting fat. He eats better than I do
Ha. Will do. Heading back to the dock
The scale house is asking about the new direct deposit form, do you have it on the shared drive?
Yes, it's in the HR folder. I'll print a few and drop them at the dock
Ladies, we need to pick the next one. I'm tired of mysteries
I vote anything with a happy ending
Nothing with a dying dog please. I'm still not over the last one
Same 😭
The one about the Nebraska homesteaders is on sale at the library book sale
I can pick up a few copies Saturday
Linda you're an angel. I'll take one
Me too, and one for Peggy
Whose turn is it to host?
Kelsey, I think
Yes! My apartment is tiny but I have a patio and a lot of chairs
I'll bring the dessert. Peach cobbler?
Yes please
I'll do the lemonade and the iced tea
Is it ok if I finish only half the book? Work has been crazy
Half counts. I'm on chapter nine and I stopped to can tomatoes
Tomatoes win every time
Don't spoil the ending. I'm reading in bed
Nobody spoil it
I'd never. (She doesn't marry the banker)
PEGGY
Reminder: club is tonight at Kelsey's, 6:30. Bring a chair if you can
Cobbler is in the oven. Smells great
Parking is behind the building, not on Grand
Thank you all for coming! That was fun
Best cobbler we've ever had
Linda left her cardigan here, tell her
Got it, I'll pick it up Thursday. Sorry!
Next pick: something light. I nominate the cozy bakery one
Seconded
Thirded
I'll put in the library hold list. We'll have a copy each by the end of the month
Linda, how do you know every librarian in the county
I bring them banana bread
Genius
Lena honey, it's Aunt Bonnie. Marlene gave me this number. Is it ok to text you here?
Of course, Bonnie! Good to hear from you
I am having my hip done on June 9 at Spencer Hospital. Russ doesn't need to know details but I wanted you gals to know
I'll bring supper over the week you're home. Any foods you can't have?
No sweet things I can't have, that's the trouble 😊 Hotdish is fine
Hotdish it is. I'll make the tater tot one you like
I have a bar to bring to Eunice's funeral lunch tomorrow and I can't find my recipe card. Do you have the lemon one?
I do. 2 cups flour, 1 cup butter, a half cup powdered sugar for the crust. Then 4 eggs, 2 cups sugar, juice of 3 lemons
Oh that's it. Bake how long?
20 minutes for the crust, then 25 more with the filling. Dust sugar when cool
God bless you. Everyone asks me for those and I lose the card every time
I took your hotdish over like I promised. Hope you're resting
Honey it was wonderful. I'm up on the walker and already bossing the physical therapist
That sounds like you
Will you and Russ come for supper when I'm on my feet? I'll do roast beef
We'd love to. Russ is baling hay through the end of the month, but after that, sure
Tell him the roast has a pie behind it. That'll get him there
That will absolutely work 😂

1 cup lard, cold
1 tsp salt
1 egg

She always said the cold is the whole secret.
